notes.title: Small but powerful update!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Dudes, Dudettes, and Duddos![/h1]

I haven't posted for more than a month but I have [b]two[/b] good reasons for that:
[h2]ONE[/h2] being the DLC for Victorian Debutante - [b]Ever After[/b] - I would have linked it in here directly but, alas, I have to show Steam gods what makes the DLC an 18+ piece. Then, they'll have to think over it for some time, so I'm not sure when I'll be able to share the store page with you (my bad, though, I need to create enough content for Steam to know what I want Ever After to be like).
[h2]TWO[/h2] - I'm remaking an old game of mine! It'll be cute and colourful and [b]bouncy[/b] just look at the logo below!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41863566/9f8effd5951243fc2c22c629d2f21e3096b57230.png[/img]
However, I don't intend Kitty Kitty Bounce Bounce to be a kid game, regardless of how sweet it seems. It will tackle some serious issues and contain a bloody secret level, so maybe don't buy it for your younger relatives and friends (I totally would but you can be better than me).
I am, however, getting ahead of myself. Let's quickly return to here and now. Today's update:
[list]
[*] texts for story 8, 9, 10, and 11 have been replaced with improved ones,
[*] ending portraits now also have hover animations, behold the beauty of breathing,
[*] new background for wiki, now it looks slightly more like a book
[/list]
That'd be it for today but I shall be back with more cool info soon enough! Until then, enjoy the summer and the Visual Novel Fest,
[h2]Stay safe and awesome![/h2]

notes.title: Hover animations are here!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Dudes, Dudettes, and Duddos![/h1]

The time has finally come and the update with hover animations is LIVE! I'm very happy with how it all turned out, with the scarce framerate making them pretty retro-looking and the sounds completing each composition. I do hope you'll share my sentiment when playing and exploring each picture anew!

I'll be uploading some animations and sounds for the ending portraits later on and enlarge the size of the game even further - I mean, with this update it's doubled and for some reason it makes me very happy. On that note, I wish you a happy and relaxing summer sale season! I'm sure I will, treating myself to some cute indie games!

notes.title: Victorian Debutante's debut on Steam Summer Sale!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Dudes, Dudettes, and Duddos![/h1]

I know the announcement's title is corny but it'd be a lie to say I'm not absolutely amazed by what it means to be. Last year, Victorian Debutante couldn't part-take in the sale because it has been published soon after. In a very short time now, my debut game will celebrate its [b]first anniversary[/b] and I - my first year as a game dev. It feels unreal and quite motivating and I know this is the way of life for me. I can't wait to put in use all the skills and knowledge I have possessed during those 12 months of being published into new projects.

[h3]ANYHOW[/h3], Victorian Debutante will be on discount for the duration of the Steam Summer sale but also on Itch Summer Sale, so you'll have some time to get yourself (or some else, for that matter!) on the platform of your choice!

Oh, and one last thing! I'm uploading a huge update with hover animations tomorrow! Can't wait to share it with you!

[h2]Stay safe and awesome![/h2]

notes.title: Hover animations
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Dudes, Dudettes, and Duddos![/h1]
I'm more than happy to be able to show up with some news not only on time but rather [i]early[/i]. I haven't been this proud of myself in a long time, let me tell you. Feels good! And I'm very hopeful that I'll be able to keep up this pace of working. Especially because I'm cooking up a special announcement for the 1st anniversary of Victorian Debutante, hehe.

[h1]Hover animations[/h1]
Before I go on to purposelessly tease you about something you probably have figured out months ago, let me show you what I'd promised in the previous post: the hover animations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41863566/020223b6df19c7bf3e021a0d87bdaee36edf2444.gif[/img]

As you can see before, I've prepared two alternatives: one on the left has less frames than the one on the right. I'd love to hear your opinion on which one you'd prefer or if I should create another one with even more frames. Should there be no replies to this announcement, I'll just update the game with the more-frame alternative because I like it more.

[h1]When will it be live?[/h1]
I'm planning to update Victorian Debutante with the animations later this month, probably on the very last day so I have the time to perfect it just in case I needed it. After that, there won't be any big exciting updates on the game itself until I find some translators who'd find being credited in the credit section enough of a payment. I wish I was joking, but alas...

I hope you're doing great and I wish you a lovely summer! Relax and have fun as much as you can but remember...
[h1]Stay safe and awesome![/h1]

notes.title: May Update but I forgot to push 'Publish'
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Dudes, Dudettes, and Duddos![/h1]

[h2]First of all, Happy Pride! Secondly, sorry for the delay! [/h2]
I was so excited I've finally figured out how to do what I wanted I forgot to push the Publish button after I updated the files. Then, I went on a trip and didn't check how the update went down. My bad, but I'll remember to check everything twice with the next one! At least, I got it done in time, as I'd promised!

[h2]May update[/h2]
As promised, you can now navigate the game using your keyboard. You can actually use both, go crazy! I also added new texts for the Bride ending and the 9th situation. 

[h2]June update[/h2]
I have finally figured out how to make the hover animations a thing and will be working hard on them, so stay tuned and be excited. Similarly to the pictures already in the game, the animations will also be hand-drawn, so don;t expect 120 fps ones, I beg of you, don't.

That'd be all from me, I hope to be telling you about how much progress I've done soon!
[h1]Stay safe and awesome![/h1]

notes.title: Belated April Update
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Dudes, Dudettes, and Duddos![/h1]

How have you been? I've certainly been well and working! I come to you with the planned April update - [b]hovers with sounds![/b] Those took some work so I hope you'll enjoy them and they'll help with the immersion. Next on my list of to do's are making the game[b] playable with keyboard[/b] and then animations for the hovers. 

[h2]May update[/h2]
The first is not on the official roadmap because I've never realised it might be something anyone would need in Victorian Debutante but I've heard some people would actually like to play the game on their laptops without having to use their mouse. I admire optimalisation of one's use of energy so of course I'll do my best to deliver.

[h2]June update[/h2]
The second, which is listed on the roadmap even before the SFX part (how much I believe in my skills and time management!) - [b]the hover animations[/b]! I plan to make them look a little choppy for two reasons. First, I'll be animating them manually because I don't know better and absolutely don't respect my time. Second, I think the effect of somewhat low fps animation will fit better with the overall mood and style of the game. In a post in the future I'll definitely ask for your opinion to check if I'm right, though.

[h2]April update[/h2]
In this update, wiki got a face lift and the hyperlinks with further reading I've promised. I had so much fun implementing that - and I'm joking just a little - and I've learnt some Unity sorcery I'll be using cheekily and irresponsibly. I didn't touch the texts themselves but I'll be improving them for the next update. Turns out Victorian Debutante is an actual book. I might publish it one day just so I can call myself a game dev and an author. 

That'll be all from me. I've been doing walks for mental health and I'm exhausted. Still, loving my life and wishing the same for you, dearies!

[h1]Stay safe and awesome![/h1]

notes.title: New Year's update
notes.content:
[h3]I've been silent for a long time but I wasn't idle! There's much I have to share with you, so let's begin with the list![/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]mini-game[/b] you could have played until now is deleted. In case you haven't noticed the mini-game mentioned, you could have "broken" the game by clicking the choice text button repeatedly, resetting the animation of the text slowly going up. Now, clicking the buttons after making a choice will have no effect. I apologise to those who had fun with it.
[*] new story images! The art is being improved, slowly but surely...
[*] ... and so are the texts! I'm revising the whole plot and all the pieces as I'm translating them. It took me a long time to realise that doing it solo will take me quite a long time so I decided to start sooner rahter than later.
[*] finally, having in mind the ones blessed with older computers and laptops, I've developed an option that helps playing the game more smoothly. How can a visual novel not be smooth? Apparently, it can, if you introduce a heavy animation, so I made an option to change the animation style to "[b]Dissolve[/b]" which is super light and still kind of cute, and "[b]No animation[/b]" which is quite self-explanatory. You can change your preferences while in the gameplay scene, I hope it'll help!
[/list]
I will be updating recommended and minimal system requirements, too, because I finally have access to more computers and laptops. Should you find some errors or have something else you'd like to share with me, I'm here for you!
Stay safe and awesome!

notes.title: Surprise post and announcement!
notes.content:
[h1]Imagine my surprise when...[/h1]
I'm currently working on implementing Steam achievements because games with those are scientifically proven to be more fun and things are going pretty wobbly but steadily in the direction of success (I'm also working on fixing some bugs, to make things more interesting and a lot harder, you can't stop me) when [i][b]suddenly[/b][/i I realise all those [i]test[/i] achievements I've preparred have gone [i]official[/i] and people can actually [i]expect[/i] to get them. I was hoping to take it easy, let myself have fun, explore the wonderous world of Steamoworks but now I'll probably be just rushing this update.

[h1]Don't get me wrong[/h1]
I do love me some challange and doing something for the first time and doing it in a speedrunner mode certainly is a challange. I was, however, going to give myself some more time to give this update some [b]juice[/b] as in substance and now I'm afraid it'll be a light version of what I have in mind. The upside is, though, it will be here [i]way[/i] sooner, so that's good, right? I'm already contradicting the global tendency to postpone game's update! Let's look at it that way, shall we?

[h1]Semi-announcement[/h1]
I will post an official and polished announcement with some nice pictures once I upload the update with achievements implemented, so treat this post as a teaser for it for now. Also, please be patient with me in the meanwhile, I'll do my best and as soon as possible. Thanks in advance, you're the best.

Stay safe and awesome!

notes.title: More fixes and improvements!
notes.content:
[h1]I'm getting the hang of it[/h1]
I think I've finally understood how to update games and how to prioritise fixes and improvements based on your feedback and my own observations. So here goes what I managed to do this week and what I'm planning on next week when I officially announce implementation of achievements.
[h1]This week:[/h1]
[list]
[*] finally fixed the jamming audio tracks and for good! I got to the bottom of the problem and changed the whole thing completely. I also modified some of the tracks to make the transitions a little smoother and nicer,
[*] I dabbled with the image transition animation and made it shorter to make it appear less slide show-y. I know it's not the solution to the problem but I'll need more time to fix it completely so it's more of a temporary thing
[*] escape button will now summon menu window when you're in the game scene, as it should have from the beginning. I'm adding this to my check-list for the next project.
[/list]
[h1]Next week:[/h1]
[list]
[*] I'll announce the implementation of achievements! I'm working on it but as I'm not quite proficient in coding, so I'm going to need some more time with it
[*] I'll smooth out saving your settings so that you don't have to change them everytime you launch the game. As of right now, I've determined the source of the problem, so that's a good start!
[/list]
Keep your fingers crossed for me because if everything goes well then I might be able to work on DLCs and release them sooner!
Stay safe and awesome!

notes.title: Another bunch of fixes before a big announcement!
notes.content:
[h1]Once again I come to improve[/h1]
I was really on the fence whether this post should be an announcement for the next step I'd planned in the roadmap or about the fixes I've been working on lately. I mean, achievements would probably bring in some more people; I would know, seeing how I myself am more likely to buy a game with some achievements. Then I realised that looking for new players for a not-so-nice or straight-up unfinished project is probably not the best idea. It's super easy to forget what it's like to buy a game when you're the one who's selling it. That realisation helped me make my decision, so...

[h1]Here's the list[/h1]
I know, I love lists, too. There's nothing better to organise things and thought neatly and comprehensively. It's also a great way to put what I'm planning to improve and fix with the next update!
[list]
[*] the music tracks jamming from time to time will finally work like they should! I'm actually super proud of this one, it did take a while!
[*] the animation that sometimes looked like a slideshow, though cute, will now hopefully work more smoothly,
[*] there will be a functionality added to the esc button! I should have thoguth about it earlier but it completely slipped my mind
[*] I've also improved some of the story pictures and will be replacing the old ones with them
[/list]
I think it's quite a nice list but it can always be bigger! Add your thoughts and ideas and if I can, I'll implement them in the next build!

[h1]Stay awesome and safe![/h1]

notes.title: Some improvements are planned, feel free to suggest more!
notes.content:
[h1]New week, new improvements[/h1]
I've been reading your comments and ideas and I've decided to put some of them into life the best I can at the moment. You'll find the list of those below but before that I'd like to say I am both shocked and grateful beyond measure for the amazing supportive community that's forming before my eyes. Thank you and I hope I won't disappoint!
[list]
[*] First of all, I noticed many people still having some troubles with the button to proceed to the next story/situation so I'll be making it more visible, probably with a text to leave not much up for guessing what the button does,
[*] Secondly, some feedback on clicking buttons is actually nice and I have no idea why I didn't implement any for my own game. I'm going to change that and quick, it'll make playing that much more fun,
[*] Thirdly, I've been working on bettering the story itself, the continouity and the characters dynamics with each others. I hope you'll enjoy the cosmetic changes and the added details. I'm adding those gradually, though, so I'll post which ones are updated in the list of changes with each update.
[/list]
Yup, so that'd be all from me but please feel free to suggest what you'd like to see in the future updates. I'll still be doing my best to stick to the roadmap and I'm super excited for the achievements but I know that before I implement those I need to improve the game itself first.

[h3]Again, thank you, you're amazing, and share your thoughts![/h3]

notes.title: First update ever, sale announcement!
notes.content:
[h1]As this is my very first game published ever[/h1], I've never really done any updates which makes today that much more special. That said I have to tell you something...
[list]
[*] Firstly, I poked around the code and Unity to find the reason for the music error happening and was able to somehow minimise the frequency of it taking place. I won't lie, I still don't know what causes it at all but I hope that once my Mentor comes back, he'll shine some wisdom upon me and help me eradicate this silly bug for good.
[*] Secondly, I put a new story in the update! I hope you'll enjoy it. I'm planning on putting 4 more in the future, so stay tuned and look out for those to come out!
[*] Thirdly, I reorganised the menu a little to both make it look better, and work better. It will now be more flexible when it comes to translating Victorian Debutante to other languages (I'm already testing it with Polish) and those pretty menu alternatives I've mentioned on the roadmap.
[/list]
I'm pretty proud of myself, to be honest. I'm feeling like an actual game developer, and a good one, at that! Not because my creation is perfect but because I listen to what players say and try to better the game the best I can.

[h1]About that sale though![/h1]
I almost went on my devving and forgot about the sale! I'm planning to put Victorian Debutante on a little sale for the first week of September and make returning to school, uni, or work this much sweeter. I will remind you about the sale in my next announcement and on the last day of it, so you remember to buy it, for you or your friends!
